issues.failure_explanation: Since m = floor(s), for 1/2 < s < 1 one has m = 0, so the hypothesis range 1/2 < r <= m = 0 is empty and the theorem as stated provides no estimate for such v. The proof nevertheless explicitly treats the case 1/2 < s <= 1 (m = 0), where assertion [2] can only be invoked with r = 0: the curl-image face space has mu = (-1,-1,mu_r), so I^{Sf}(curl v) = 0 and the bound used is ||curl(v - I^{Se}v)|| = ||curl v||, i.e., the r = 0 case that the stated hypothesis 1/2 < r excludes. The proof thus needs a parameter case the statement does not admit.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restate the curl regularity hypothesis as 0 <= r <= m, noting that r > 1/2 is required only when m >= 1 (where face normal traces of curl v are needed); the m = 0, r = 0 case is exactly what the proof already uses.
issues.overall_effect: The lowest-order/low-regularity regime 1/2 < s < 1 of the edge serendipity interpolation theorem is vacuous as stated, even though the proof derives estimates there and assertion [1] is designed with the low-regularity term h_K||curl v||_K.
issues.title: thmve's curl regularity range 1/2 < r <= m is empty for m = 0
issues.why_classification: A local hypothesis correction for a degenerate parameter case; the proof already contains the needed r = 0 argument, no estimate or advertised scope changes, and no dependent result relies on the m = 0 case.

issues.failure_explanation: In eqcomm [2], the interpolant I^{Sf} maps into the curl-image face serendipity space V^{Sf}_mu with mu = (beta_r,-1,mu_r) = (m-1,-1,mu_r). thmvf is stated only for spaces V^{Sf}_{m_f, m_f-1, k_r} containing P^3_{m_f}. For m >= 2 the curl-image space has k_d = -1, not m_f - 1 = m-2, and it cannot contain P^3_{m-1}: membership in V^f_{(m-1,-1,mu_r)} requires div p in P_{-1} = {0}, whereas e.g. p(x) = (x_1,0,0) in P^3_{m-1} has div p = 1. Hence thmvf is used outside its stated hypotheses and no divergence-free variant is established; thmve [2], and with it thmve [1] whose proof invokes [2], is unproved as written for m >= 2.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Extend the serendipity face construction (defvs with S the divergence-free polynomials) to k_d = -1 and prove the corresponding divergence-free variant of thmvf for V^{Sf}_{(m-1,-1,mu_r)}, for which the needed divergence-free polynomial approximation is standard; then thmve [2] follows from eqcomm [2] as before.
issues.overall_effect: Both assertions of the edge serendipity interpolation theorem lack a valid proof for order m >= 2, leaving the paper's optimal H(curl) approximation estimate unsupported.
issues.title: thmve [2] applies thmvf to the divergence-free curl-image face space outside its hypotheses
issues.why_classification: The repair requires a contained new variant of the existing serendipity construction and interpolation proof, but no change to the overall architecture, the estimates, or the advertised scope; the conclusions remain intact once the variant is supplied.

issues.failure_explanation: Under the stated hypothesis v in H^s(K), the right-hand side |grad v|_{s,K} = |v|_{s+1,K} requires v in H^{s+1}, which is not assumed. Moreover, the only route the paper has (thmve applied to grad v in H^{s-1}) yields at best h^{s-1}|grad v|_{s-1}, i.e., h^{s-1}|v|_s: the gradient of V^{Sn}_{m,...} lies in an edge space containing only grad P_m (polynomial degree m-1), whose L^2 approximation rate is capped at h^m. The stated bound h^s|grad v|_s is one power too high; for s in (m, m+1] it claims an H^1 error of order h^{m+1} for a space containing only P_m, whose best possible H^1 rate is h^m.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restate the conclusion as ||grad(v - I^{Sn} v)||_K \lesssim h_K^{s-1} |v|_{s,K} for v in H^s(K), 3/2 < s <= m+1 (equivalently keep h^s|grad v|_s but assume grad v in H^s and restrict to s <= m); this is the standard optimal H^1 estimate and is what the thmve route delivers.
issues.overall_effect: As stated, the node serendipity interpolation theorem is false at the top of its range and its right-hand side is not finite under the stated regularity; what the construction supports is the standard optimal estimate h^{s-1}|v|_s.
issues.title: Node interpolation theorem states one power of h too many: h^s|grad v|_s under v in H^s
issues.why_classification: The least repair is a local one-line restatement to the standard optimal H^1 rate; the advertised optimal-approximation property and the 3/2 < s <= m+1 scope survive, only the unattainable super-optimal boundary rate is dropped, and no new argument is needed for the statement itself (the missing proof is a separate issue).

issues.failure_explanation: eqcomm [3] reads grad(I^{Sn} v) = I^{Se}(grad v), where I^{Se} maps into the node-paired edge space V^{Se}_{(m-1,k_f,-1),k_v,-1} (node definition: grad v in V^e_{beta,k_v,-1} with beta = (k-1,k_f,-1)). thmve is stated only for serendipity edge spaces with beta = (m',beta_d,m'-1) containing P^3_{m'}. For the relevant order m' = m-1 >= 1 the node-paired space has beta_r = -1, not m'-1, and P^3_{m-1} is not contained in it: membership requires curl p in V^f_{(-1,-1,-1)}, forcing (curl p).n_F = 0 on every face, which excludes e.g. p(x) = (x_2,0,0) in P^3_{m-1} with curl p = (0,0,-1). Hence thmve cannot be applied to grad v, and the node-space estimate (even the corrected h^{s-1}|v|_s version) is unsupported as written; indeed this edge space also falls outside the paper's own serendipity edge space definition, which requires P^3_{m'} subseteq V^e.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Prove the node-space H^1 interpolation estimate directly: DoF duality for the serendipity perturbation ||I^n v - I^{Sn} v|| plus standard node-element estimates, mirroring the proofs of thmvf/thmve (scalar Bramble-Hilbert applies since P_m subseteq V^{Sn}); alternatively extend thmve to curl-free edge spaces.
issues.overall_effect: The H^1 approximation property of the serendipity node space has no valid proof for order m >= 2; the claimed optimal approximation properties of the full node-edge-face serendipity family are not established.
issues.title: thm:added-1's proof applies thmve to the curl-free gradient-image edge space outside its hypotheses
issues.why_classification: The repair needs a contained nontrivial argument (a variant of the existing interpolation proofs) but no new global proof architecture and no change to the corrected statement or the method's advertised scope; the resulting estimate remains the standard optimal one.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Denote the limit by \(\left\|\bm{\mathit{\Pi}}\boldsymbol{\psi}^\infty_{i}\right\|\). By the density of polynomials, \(\left\|\bm{\mathit{\Pi}}\boldsymbol{\psi}^\infty_{i}\right\|=\left\|\boldsymbol{\psi}^\infty_{i}\right\|\).

issues.failure_explanation: The object psi_i^infty is never defined as a function: the spaces V^S_l, and hence their Lagrange bases psi_i^l, vary with l, and only a limit of norms is taken, so the displayed 'density' equality has no defined meaning and does not show that the projections asymptotically capture the basis functions. The concluding implication 'the Lagrange bases are linearly independent, therefore M^l becomes full row rank for some l' is a non sequitur: linear independence of bases of the varying spaces V^S_l does not by itself imply injectivity of Pi_l on V^S_l for any l. The essential missing step is to exclude a nonzero preserved-DoF coefficient vector whose moments against all polynomials vanish (using the claimed l-independence of the columns of M^l, a nested-kernel argument in R^{N_S}, and density of polynomials); without it the existence of a stabilizing l is unproved.

failure_location.quote:
Since the Lagrange bases are linear independent, there
  must be some \(l\) making \(\mathbf{M}^l\) full row rank.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Complete the rank argument: with the columns of M^l independent of l (as argued in the proof), the left kernels of M^l form a decreasing chain of subspaces of R^{N_S}; if all were nontrivial, a unit vector in their intersection would define v in V^S_l with (v,p) = 0 for all polynomials p, forcing v = 0 by density of polynomials and contradicting unisolvence of the preserved DoFs. Hence some M^l has full row rank, and finite-dimensional norm equivalence gives ||Pi_l v|| approximately equal ||v|| on V^S_l.
issues.overall_effect: thm:added-2 is the paper's central stabilization-free guarantee; as its proof stands, the existence of a stable computable polynomial projection, and hence the equivalent discrete bilinear forms and the method's main claim, rests on an unproven step.
issues.title: Existence of a stable projection order l is not proved: full-rank step is a non sequitur via an undefined limit object
issues.why_classification: The statement is salvaged by a contained functional-analytic lemma whose ingredients (moment l-independence, density of polynomials, finite dimension) are already present in the proof; no new global proof architecture is needed and no claim or guarantee changes.
